en.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Consolation, Kevelaer
en.summary: One of the largest pilgrimage sites in northwestern Europe, built around a small devotional print venerated since the 1640s.
en.body: Growing from a wayside shrine established in 1642 around a small printed image of Our Lady of Luxembourg, the basilica at Kevelaer became one of the most visited Marian pilgrimage sites in Germany and the wider region.
